response.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) as avg_round, COUNT(*) as num_races, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn FROM stats), tenth_share AS (SELECT share FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10) SELECT circuitId, avg_round, num_races, share FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 OR share IN (SELECT share FROM tenth_share) ORDER BY share DESC
